Harper: Short follow-up from today's all-hands on the service incident. RCA here: https://redwood.company/rca/INC-2026-042. Using this thread to capture action owners, short ETAs, and the leadership Q&A items. Keep it brief. :spiral_notepad:

Diego: I'll own the rollback playbook + canary script. ETA 2026-03-28T09:00Z. I'll add steps to `ops/playbooks/kv-rollback.md` and include smoke tests.

Nina: I'll update the oncall runbook and add new alert thresholds (stall_rate > 0.015 for 3m). ETA 2026-03-28T13:00Z.

Liu: I'll draft the customer-facing note for Hosted and Dedicated tiers and coordinate Legal/PR. Draft 1 by 2026-03-28T17:00Z.

OpsBot: Created follow-up task INC-2026-042-AH and linked sub-tasks: https://redwood.company/tasks/INC-2026-042-AH.

Harper: Leadership Qs to capture: 1) Any immediate SLO changes? 2) Temporary Dedicated reservations? 3) Who owns the 7-day regression watch?

Diego: No SLO change today; will propose micro-adjustments if rollback does not restore baseline within 72h.

Liu: We can offer a 48h Dedicated buffer for critical accounts with Ops approval; I'll prepare the outreach template once we have the list.

Nina: Platform Reliability will run the 7-day elevated watch; I'll post a morning snapshot here daily.

Diego: Smoke test commands I'll include in the playbook:
```n# restart cache proxy and check hit rate
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/kv-proxy
curl -sS http://internal-metrics/kv | jq .kv_hit_rate
```

Nina: Prometheus alert expression: `increase(kv_stall_total[3m]) / increase(kv_req_total[3m]) > 0.015`. Dashboard panel added.

Liu: Draft comms posted: https://redwood.company/drafts/comm-INC-2026-042. Tagging @Legal and @PR.

Harper: Final asks: drop a 1-2 line "ops change" blurb for next all-hands slide by EOD tomorrow and post final doc/task links here. I'll compile the action tracker and schedule a 48h sync.

Diego: Blurb: "Rolled back a KV cache change, tightened detection thresholds, and initiated a 7-day elevated monitoring window with targeted Dedicated capacity options."

Harper: Thanks everyone. Closing this thread for new topics; append links only so I can export the tracker. :white_check_mark:
